tasks.task: Open the odds board and read the implied win probability shown for the Celtics @ Knicks game's best price.
tasks.expected: It reads 55.6%, derived from the best home price of -125 at HoopLine — not 56.5%, which would mean it was computed from BetNova's -130.

tasks.task: Find the Nuggets @ Raptors game on the odds board and look at how the best price is marked.
tasks.expected: The +170 price is flagged as best at both BetNova and CourtSide — both books marked — while HoopLine's +165 is not marked as best.

tasks.task: Look at the Warriors @ Mavericks game on the odds board.
tasks.expected: CourtSide's -148 is highlighted as the best home price, not HoopLine's -155 — for negative American odds the number closest to even money is the better payout.

tasks.task: Scan the six games on the odds board.
tasks.expected: Every matchup is written away team @ home team (e.g. Celtics @ Knicks) and every price carries an explicit + or - sign in American form, with no decimal odds anywhere.

tasks.task: Navigate to the team rankings section.
tasks.expected: A ranked list of basketball teams is displayed with standings information for each team.
